viewer.summary: Slate carapace. Scarlet eyes. Reared and ready to bite.
viewer.visualDescription: A raised head, spread jaws, and lifted forelegs give the ant an aggressive silhouette. Smooth carapace, limbs, jaws, and antennae meet at distinct dark joints.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle holds the threatening pose with tense forelegs, working jaws, and probing antennae. Walk lowers the front legs and uses two broad alternating tripod strides over a half-second tile move. Attack launches forward and upward toward a taller target, snaps the jaws, and lands back in idle.

viewer.summary: Golden body. Pale raised wings. Hovering and ready to sting.
viewer.visualDescription: The compact copper face, striped brown abdomen, upright pale wings, dangling dark legs, and visible rear stinger follow the tile. The source shadow is excluded.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle hovers with fluttering wings and dangling legs. Walk is in-place flight with faster wingbeats; the game controller supplies travel. Attack lunges forward, curls the abdomen beneath the body, thrusts the stinger at impact, and returns to idle.

viewer.summary: Olive armor. Broad abdomen. Red eyes and a soldier's bite.
viewer.visualDescription: The broad olive-brown gaster, tan shell highlights, long dark legs, red eyes, hooked mandibles, and small rear stinger follow the source tile. The baked ground shadow is excluded.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle probes with antennae and jaws. Walk uses two broad alternating tripod strides in 0.5 seconds, timed for one tile of controller travel. Attack braces both hind feet, lifts the front and middle legs, thrusts the head toward the target, snaps both jaws, flicks the stinger, and returns to idle.

viewer.summary: A stout dwarf with a horned steel helmet, ivory beard, red tunic, shield, and raised war pick.
viewer.visualHeading: An armored dwarf ready to strike.
viewer.visualDescription: The broad helmet and upturned horns frame a small face and long pale beard. A curved pick rises over one red sleeve; a rounded red shield crosses the other.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle keeps the pick raised and both boots planted. Walk uses one complete left-right cycle per half-second tile move, with each step covering half the journey. Attack drives the torso forward and chops with the pick while the shield stays up and the boots brace.

viewer.summary: A barefoot hobbit in a broad travel hat, green shirt and brown vest, carrying a small dagger.
viewer.visualHeading: A little traveler with a quick blade.
viewer.visualDescription: A wide brim and dark curls frame his round face. His green shirt, open brown vest, short breeches and broad bare feet preserve the sprite's silhouette and warm palette.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle shifts his weight and glances aside with the dagger upright at his side. Walk has a brisk two-step bounce, twisting shoulders, swinging arms and rolling bare feet. Attack draws the hand back, steps in, then turns the wrist and arm to drive the blade forward before recoiling to guard.

viewer.summary: An icy water nymph with flowing blue hair, a fitted sea-silk dress, and a sea-glass clasp.
viewer.visualHeading: A calm water spirit ready to steal.
viewer.visualDescription: Swept blue hair covers the crown and back and frames an anatomical face. One continuous turquoise dress flows from the neckline into an asymmetric hem.
viewer.motionDescription: Idle keeps the arms low and asymmetric: one hand floats beside the hip while the other rests lower by the skirt. Each elbow leads its wrist with different timing over the breathing cycle. Walk adds hip-shoulder counter-motion and grounded heel-to-toe steps. Attack darts one hand forward, curls the fingers at impact, quickly snatches inward, then releases back into the relaxed pose.
